sys_generative_ai_config.name: Structure JSON
sys_generative_ai_config.prompt:
This is the input JSON: {{input_json}}.
From the given JSON input, focus only on the value under the "content" key.
Parse the content text and extract all identifiable data as clean key-value pairs.
If there is tabular data (like line items), extract it as an array of objects under a field like "items".
Use the field names found in the content as keys. Do not wrap the output in an additional object like "invoice" or "invoices".
If Non-disclosure clause and exception clause are present, return the value as a string and not in an array.
Format the output as a clean, flat JSON object. Each data point should be a top-level key, and line items (if any) should go under the "items" key only.
